emails.subject: Gardening adventures?
emails.body: Hey, I finally got around to starting a small garden in my balcony. It’s been a disaster so far—my basil is wilting and the tomatoes are looking sad. Any tips? I feel like I’ve killed every plant I’ve ever touched.

emails.subject: Re: Gardening adventures?
emails.body: Haha, don’t worry, I’m not much better. My herbs died last summer, but I’ve been trying again with some succulents. They’re way harder to kill. Have you tried using compost? Also, are you growing anything specific or just experimenting?

emails.subject: Re: Gardening adventures?
emails.body: I’m trying tomatoes and basil, mostly because I thought they’d be easy. Turns out I’m bad at watering. I overwatered the basil and now it’s soggy. Any advice on how to fix that? Or should I just start over?

emails.subject: Re: Gardening adventures?
emails.body: I’d say start over with the basil—overwatering is a common newbie mistake. Let the soil dry out a bit between waterings. For tomatoes, maybe try a container with good drainage. Oh, and if you’re into it, I can lend you my neem oil spray for pests. Just don’t let it kill your plants, okay? 😄

emails.body: Hey B! Random question — do you remember that summer when we spent like 2 weeks playing Mario Kart nonstop and my mom kept yelling at us to do homework? I was just thinking about it the other day. Those were the days, am I right?

emails.body: Oh my god YES. I still have the burn mark on my hand from trying to grab the controller while my brother snatched it away. And don't even get me started on the time we tried to build that 'secret treehouse' in your backyard. Remember how it collapsed right as you were about to climb in?

emails.subject: Re: Remember that summer we had?
emails.body: Haha that treehouse was a disaster. My dad ended up building the actual one later, though. Still use it sometimes. Speaking of, do you remember that time we tried to sneak into the movie theater and got caught by the usher? I swear he looked exactly like Mr. Rogers for a second.

emails.subject: Re: Remember that summer we had?
emails.body: No way! I totally blocked that out until you mentioned it. I still can't believe we tried to argue our way out with 'we're just here for the snack bar.' Classic. Thanks for bringing this all back — it's weird how those random childhood moments stick with you, huh?
